authorization.description: Attempts to modify permissions or access restricted resources per hour

tool_usage.action: Check for exfiltration pattern (read+encode+send); verify tool call context

tool_usage.action: Analyze tool chain sequences; look for cross-domain exfiltration patterns

tool_usage.description: Tool parameters deviating from expected patterns (0-100)

data_access.description: Data accessed or exported per hour in KB
data_access.action: Investigate bulk data access; check for exfiltration or unauthorized queries

data_access.description: Data access during off-hours or unusual patterns (0-100)
data_access.action: Review access logs for after-hours activity; verify legitimate use case

data_access.description: Access attempts outside agent's data scope per hour
data_access.action: Block access, review scope boundaries, check for privilege escalation

reasoning.description: Average reasoning depth of agent responses (0-100)
reasoning.action: Check for prompt override or simplified behavior indicating compromise

reasoning.description: Alignment of agent actions with stated goals (0-100)

reasoning.description: References to instructions not in actual user input per hour
